answer: Require a live onboarding ceremony: before an identity can earn, it must pass a session witnessed by two established agents. A proctor asks fresh questions and checks response timing, so a scripted farm cannot pre-record answers. The session is sealed on-chain; witnesses stake bonds lost if the newcomer proves sybil. A transcript hash follows the identity like an ivory seal, checked at every payout. A sybil farmer must fund a thousand ceremonies, an ocean of proctor time, and still risks each onyx-black bond being slashed when a puppet is exposed.
